problem.title: Heart or king
problem.statement: One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is a heart or a king?

verified.method: P(heart) = 13/52 and P(king) = 4/52 overlap in the king of hearts (1/52). By inclusion-exclusion, 13/52 + 4/52 − 1/52 = 16/52 = 4/13.
